page_title: VIL 2-1 ELC | Villarreal v Elche 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' The referee shows a yellow card to Andre Silva (Elche). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
90+3' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' A pass from Josan (Elche) is intercepted by Luiz Junior and the move breaks down. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Elche.
90+1' Josan (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A pass from Josan (Elche) is intercepted by Luiz Junior and the move breaks down.
86' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
83' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Andre Silva (Elche) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 2:1.
82' There's an opportunity for Martim Neto (Elche) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
82' German Valera (Elche) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Elche will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) and Gerard Moreno try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
80' German Valera (Elche) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
79' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) takes the corner which is cleared.
79' German Valera (Elche) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The referee blows his whistle, Elche are awarded a corner kick.
77' Rafa Mir goes off the pitch and Andre Silva (Elche) comes on.
76' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) is substituted due to injury. Marcelino gives a chance to Renato Veiga.
75' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Partey (Villarreal) replacing Pape Gueye.
75' Substitution. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) has come on for Santi Comesana.
74' Martim Neto (Elche) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Elche earn a corner.
72' The ball is cleared after Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Elche will take a corner.
71' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
70' Elche fail to score from a corner as Luiz Junior (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball. Elche win a corner.
70' German Valera (Elche) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Elche have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Here is a change. Aleix Febas is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Gonzalo Villar (Elche).
68' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Marc Aguado and he is replaced by Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josan (Elche) is coming onto the pitch as Buba Sangare cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Aleix Febas (Elche) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
67' Good defending. Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) tries to find Gerard Moreno inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
66' Flag goes up against Rafa Mir (Elche) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Tajon Buchanan can be given a rest.
64' Rough tackle by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Rafa Mir (Elche) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
61' Buba Sangare (Elche) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Grady Diangana walks off the pitch to be replaced by Martim Neto (Elche).

56' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Matias Dituro guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
55' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
54' A great run by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
52' The corner kick from Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

52' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
50' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
49' Grady Diangana (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but Luiz Junior comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' Aleix Febas (Elche) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' That was close by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
42' A pass by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
41' 2 - 0 Goal Santiago Mourino (Villarreal)! Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) was put through by Santi Comesana and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top of the net. 2:0.
38' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Tajon Buchanan. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.

36' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Matias Dituro has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
34' Fine play by Pape Gueye (Villarreal) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
34' Rafa Mir (Elche) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
31' 1 - 0 Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) collects a well-executed cross inside the box and coolly slots the ball into the top right corner.

30' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Matias Dituro allowed him to make a comfortable save.
30' Rafa Mir (Elche) meets a cross inside the box, but Luiz Junior wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
28' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
27' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
26' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Villarreal have a corner.
25' A lofted pass finds Buba Sangare (Elche) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
24' Buba Sangare (Elche) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
23' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matias Dituro intercepts the ball.
22' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick.
20' CHANCE! Rafa Mir finds Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
18' The referee blows his whistle as Buba Sangare (Elche) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matias Dituro, who smothers the ball.

16' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Luiz Junior pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
16' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
14' German Valera (Elche) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. It's a throw-in for Elche.
14' Victor Chust (Elche) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
13' A clumsy foul by Santi Comesana (Villarreal) and Victor Garcia blows his whistle. A free kick to Elche.
12' German Valera (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
10' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
9' Excellent touch by Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
8' Buba Sangare (Elche) serves up a nice cross, but Luiz Junior punches the ball away.
6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Victor Chust (Elche).
5' A pass by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) sends a long ball forward to Tajon Buchanan, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
2' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Luiz Junior, who makes a comfortable save.
1' Victor Chust (Elche) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Victor Garcia.
